prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a new dedicated INTERCEPT mission objective icon for the Stellarion space strategy game, designed to be read at 40–54 pixels. Input images 1 and 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their classic sci-fi strategy-game glossy colored glass/enamel rounded-square tile, thin beveled gold double rim and cream inner edge, strong ivory pictogram, tight framing. Create ONE square icon. The central pictogram depicts two clearly separate small spacecraft on converging flight paths: an interceptor cutting across an incoming ship's course, their two short bold trajectory strokes converging on a small four-point contact spark. Use very simple solid ivory ship silhouettes and generous negative space so the idea of meeting and stopping a moving fleet is readable at tiny size. Rich deep cobalt-blue enamel background with restrained glass highlights. The square frame nearly fills the canvas with only a thin transparent outer margin. Genuine transparent pixels outside the rounded gold frame. No circular target reticle, no crosshair, no radar sweep, no shield, no text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark or extra icons. The symbol should visually communicate a fleet rendezvous ambush, independently of any combat tactic.

hover_illustration.purpose: Distinct Intercept objective hover illustration: a warm close-range ambush contrasted with Patrol's cool, orderly search formation.
hover_illustration.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: replacement INTERCEPT mission objective hover illustration for the Stellarion space strategy game. One square, full-bleed narrative painting that reads clearly at 150x150 pixels, for a 200x200 source asset. Primary request: make Intercept immediately distinguishable from the Patrol hover painting. Input images: 1 Attack cover and 2 Protect cover are STYLE references for the game's classic early-2000s sci-fi digital painting, weathered metal, slightly soft textured brushwork and dramatic localized glow. Image 3 Light Fighter and image 4 Battleship are SHIP IDENTITY references: the compact silver fighter has a pointed orange cockpit and angular swept wings; the enemy Battleship has a broad rounded maroon armored bow, pale forward slit and long mechanical aft body. Image 5 Patrol cover is a CONTRAST reference only: do not reuse its composition, long dark cruiser, loose escort formation, or cool blue diagonal nebula. New scene: an unmistakable sudden close-range deep-space ambush. View from high above and behind a large silver interceptor banking hard across the upper-left foreground, its angular swept-wing silhouette strongly readable. Below and to the right, the recognizable broad maroon enemy Battleship is crossing its path, caught in a brilliant localized amber impact flash on its forward flank. A second much smaller silver interceptor cuts across from the opposite side. Show a few short red-orange weapon streaks and a curling hot exhaust trail so the opposing flight directions and abrupt engagement are obvious. Strong asymmetrical crossing composition with ships on different headings, not an escort formation; no long cruiser spanning the top half. Dark charcoal and smoky rusty-red space, amber-gold combat lighting, hot white impact center, restrained blue highlights only on silver hulls. Dramatic close crop and large simple shapes for a tiny hover thumbnail. Keep the recognizable ship designs and the existing painted game aesthetic. No nearby planet or planetary bombardment, no giant fireball consuming the scene, no radar, UI, reticle, arrows, diagram lines, symbols, icon tile, frame, badge, border, lettering, numbers, logo or watermark. Opaque square background.
hover_illustration.processing: Downsampled the generated painting to the established 200x200 RGB cover format using Lanczos resampling. Runtime textures are generated by the standard asset pipeline.
